calculation.description: Ranks assets by recent momentum acceleration relative to their medium-term pace, normalized by trailing 20-day annualized volatility. The 0.05 floor stabilizes low-volatility yield and defensive series. Higher values indicate stronger recent acceleration per unit of risk.

validation.regime_notes: Aggregate 10-day IC and ICIR pass strongly, but recent 2029 regime IC is negative (-0.039205) and 20-day decay is negative; use conservatively at the 10-day horizon and monitor sign drift. The 2027 segment was strongly positive. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative interpretation of IC uncertainty.
